retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical group portrait featuring figures in heavy dark cloaks arranged within a geometric architectural structure, paired with bold yellow display type and white script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure surrounded by other men and children, all draped in heavy, dark olive-green cloaks. They are positioned inside a wooden gazebo or pavilion with visible rafters. The lighting is soft and natural, creating a moody, theatrical atmosphere. The layout features a large, bold, yellow sans-serif title at the top and a white, slanted script title at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical arrangement of figures around a central axis
Contrast between dark, heavy fabric and pale skin tones
Geometric framing provided by the pavilion structure
Primary color contrast between yellow top text and white bottom text
coreInvariants: Heavy dark olive-green cloaks concealing the bodies of all subjects
Symmetrical placement of adult men and children
Wooden pavilion ceiling rafters converging toward the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is slightly larger and lower, with other figures tiered upward and outward in a V-shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central man's face and the child directly in front of him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold yellow title down the central axis to the script text, then outward to the flanking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is densely packed with the heavy fabric of the cloaks.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm wood tones (pavilion) and pale skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow (top text) and white (bottom text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image balanced by high-value, high-saturation typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy condensed sans-serif and upright brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extra-bold, condensed, flat-sided caps
Bottom text: Fluid, connected script with a slight rightward slant and thick-to-thin modulation
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a rigid, industrial sans-serif and a soft, organic script.
graphicDevices: Thin black outlines on text for legibility

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-sided aesthetic of the top text.
Captures the mid-century calligraphic feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical photograph of a group of men and children in a wooden pavilion, all wearing heavy dark olive-green cloaks that cover their bodies, leaving only their faces visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line centered title in bold yellow condensed sans-serif at the top, and a two-line centered title in white brush script at the bottom with a subtle black drop shadow.
